name: Search & Research Profile
description: Layered retrieval, analytical synthesis, deep technical research, and evidence extraction

optional_specialists.trigger: Community opinion, emerging ecosystem trends, or freshness < 30 days
Interactive web app navigation, JavaScript execution, or authenticated QA

routing_flow: 1. Firecrawl: Scrape, crawl, and retrieve authoritative documentation and GitHub repos
2. DeerFlow: Analyze, reconcile discrepancies, and structure synthesized findings
3. Last30Days (conditional): Ingest recent developer discussions (Reddit, HN, X)
4. Browser Use (conditional): Execute live browser automation only if static retrieval fails
5. Source Reconciliation: Verify citations and evidence before reporting
release_gate: All claims have primary source URLs or commit references
Conflicting evidence or documentation discrepancies are reconciled
Anecdotal community opinions are clearly marked and corroborated
No halluncinated or unverified API signatures
